# runpod_global_volume (Resource)

A global volume: usage-billed storage that is not tied to a data center. Only a name is configured; the API provisions the storage, and an account can hold a limited number of global volumes. Deleting one deletes its data, and fails while any pod (stopped pods included) or serverless endpoint still mounts it.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "runpod_global_volume" "training_data" {
  name = "training-data"
}

# A global volume has no data center, so the pod that mounts it can be placed
# anywhere. The path is optional; the API chooses one when it is left out.
resource "runpod_pod" "trainer" {
  name        = "trainer"
  image       = "runpod/pytorch:2.8.0-py3.11-cuda12.8.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04"
  gpu_type_id = "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090"

  global_volumes = [{
    volume_id = runpod_global_volume.training_data.id
    path      = "/data"
  }]
}

output "global_volume_id" {
  description = "Identifier of the global volume."
  value       = runpod_global_volume.training_data.id
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this resource live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name, 1 to 191 characters, with no leading or trailing whitespace. Need not be unique. Changing it renames the volume in place.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the volume was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) Identifier of the user who created the volume; null when the API has no creator recorded.
- `id` (String) Global volume identifier assigned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Global volumes are imported by volume id.
terraform import runpod_global_volume.training_data gsb_abc
```
